title: Family and Community Life
description: A comprehensive learning path covering Islamic family life from marriage to community building. This roadmap guides learners through the spiritual significance of marriage, parenting with Islamic values, fulfilling family rights and responsibilities, strengthening family bonds, and contributing to the Muslim community. Based on Quran and Sunnah, this path provides timeless guidance for building thriving Muslim families and societies.

courses.note: Foundational knowledge of Islamic marriage from proposal to building a lasting relationship
Raising children with Islamic principles and prophetic guidance
Understanding the mutual rights and duties of family members
Practical strategies for strengthening family bonds and resilience
Contributing to the Muslim community and fostering collective wellbeing
